method: Include a direct NASA movie only when its page explicitly names the featured object or describes the clip's purpose, or gives a time to an example. These links complement narrated passages and geographically matched crop movies; a clip does not provide a dated object footprint.

assets.source_basis: NASA directs viewers to 2:30 in the temperature version for trapped warm water in an eddy; it supplies no individual eddy name.
